title: Semgrep / CodeQL source triage
steps: `semgrep --config auto .` for a quick baseline; add a focused rule for the framework's sink (SQL, exec, template, deserialize).
For deeper dataflow, `codeql database create db --language=<lang>` then `codeql database analyze db <suite> --format=sarif-latest`.
Triage by reachability: is the sink reachable from an unauthenticated route/input?
Confirm with one benign request or a local unit test; do not report an unconfirmed static hit.
falsifier: No source-to-sink path or a sanitizer/allowlist blocks the input.
